ourStory.title: Our Story
paragraphs: Saint Mary's Fellowship Hall in Dacula is a brand-new facility and event venue that belongs to the Saint Mary's Church serving American-Romanian community in the area.

The property is an expression of our identity, a fingerprint of our presence in the area and our contribution to Gwinnett's multi-cultural society. It is also an expression of our community at its best, through the sacrifice and dedication of a small but very active group of members.

aboutYou.title: It's All About You
paragraphs: Our renting facility stands out in the area with a new and large parking space, beautiful green space around, privacy for your events, flexible hours, brand new building with modern design and multiple options for decorations.

faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subheading: Everything you need to know before booking your Dacula event.

items.question: What is the guest capacity of Fellowship Event Hall?
items.answer: Fellowship Event Hall comfortably seats up to 250 guests and can accommodate up to 300 attendees for standing receptions. The space is approximately 5,000 square feet.

items.question: Where is Fellowship Event Hall located?
items.answer: We are located at 2875 Winder Hwy, Dacula, GA 30019 — roughly 45 minutes northeast of downtown Atlanta, and convenient to Lawrenceville, Buford, Hoschton, Duluth, and Suwanee.

items.question: Is parking available on site?
items.answer: Yes. Our property includes a large on-site parking lot with ample space for your guests at no additional charge.

items.question: Can we bring in our own catering and alcohol?
items.answer: Yes — outside catering is welcome, and our prep kitchen is available to vendors. Alcohol is permitted under our standard rental guidelines, which we will review with you before booking.

items.question: What is included in the rental?
items.answer: Every rental includes tables and chairs, tablecloths and chair covers, a basic sound system, on-site parking, an on-site coordinator, and setup and cleanup assistance. Higher-tier packages add premium linens, a bridal suite, enhanced sound and lighting, and dedicated coordination.

items.question: How do we book a tour or check availability?
items.answer: Private venue tours are available by appointment. Use the contact form or send a WhatsApp message and we will follow up promptly with open dates.
